text:
emma_marketing: Need a small visual sprint for next-week inbound push: 4 benchmark tiles + 2 webinar hero frames. Light + dark, two colorways, localized EN-US / EN-GB / FR. Deadline: Fri EOD. Can design confirm capacity?

anya_design: We can do it. Quick Qs: exact export sizes and whether paid widths are needed? Also illustrations or photos?

sam_creative: Recommend illustrations (avoid partner logos). Add a tiny 3-point sparkline to each tile to visualize latency vs cost. I can mock the data.

leo_ops: Naming convention please: campaign_region_variant_lang_size.png (example: inbound_na_nebula_en-US_tile1200x800.png). If you give a CSV, I can bulk ingest for routing.

emma_marketing: Good call. Sizes: tile 1200x800, social square 1080x1080, paid 1200x628, hero 1920x1080 + email header 800x1000. PNG final, SVG for icons/sparklines, layered Figma file.

anya_design: Noted. I'll include short + long headline lockups for each language and both themes. Figma link will be posted when drafts ready. Safe margin 48px, provide WCAG contrast notes.

figma-bot: Task created CR-4312 -> anya_design. Assets: 4 tiles (2 colorways x light/dark) + 2 heroes + social & paid crops + SVG sparklines + export package. Due 2026-03-28 17:00 UTC.

claire_legal: Legal check: avoid unverified superlatives ("industry-leading"). If any partner imagery is used, get IP clearance. Send final copy to legal for sign-off. Alt text required for each image.

nina_marketing: I'll be the final marketing approver. I'll review first proofs Thu morning. If legal requests edits, we'll hold publish.

anya_design: Will deliver mockups Thu morning, internal review Thu afternoon, legal Thu evening, Nina final signoff Fri AM. I'll attach export CSV with filename, alt_text, short_description and campaign_id for Leo to ingest.

emma_marketing: Perfect. If anyone needs extra paid sizes (stories / 9:16), call it out now. Otherwise proceed with spec above. :rocket:
